items.source: IndexResolver provides an abstraction for programmatic index definition creation if you want to make use of @Indexed annotations such as @GeoSpatialIndexed, @TextIndexed, @CompoundIndex and @WildcardIndexed. You can use index definitions with IndexOperations to create indexes. A good point in time for index creation is on application startup, specifically after the application context was refreshed, triggered by observing ContextRefreshedEvent. This event guarantees that the context is fully initialized. Note that at this time other components, especially bean factories might have access to the MongoDB database.
items.translation:
`IndexResolver` 提供了一种抽象机制，用于程序化地创建索引定义。如果您希望利用 `@Indexed` 注解（如 `@GeoSpatialIndexed`、`@TextIndexed`、`@CompoundIndex` 和 `@WildcardIndexed`），可以使用此功能。您可以结合 `IndexOperations` 使用索引定义来创建索引。

创建索引的最佳时机是在应用程序启动时，具体而言是在应用程序上下文刷新之后。这可以通过监听 `ContextRefreshedEvent` 事件来实现。该事件能够确保上下文已完全初始化。请注意，此时其他组件（尤其是 Bean 工厂）可能已经可以访问 MongoDB 数据库。

items.source: Creating a text index allows accumulating several fields into a searchable full-text index. It is only possible to have one text index per collection, so all fields marked with @TextIndexed are combined into this index. Properties can be weighted to influence the document score for ranking results. The default language for the text index is English.To change the default language, set the language attribute to whichever language you want (for example,@Document(language="spanish")). Using a property called language or @Language lets you define a language override on a per-document base. The following example shows how to created a text index and set the language to Spanish:
items.translation: 创建文本索引可以将多个字段累积到一个可搜索的全文索引中。每个集合只能有一个文本索引，因此所有标记为 @TextIndexed 的字段都会合并到此索引中。可以通过对属性进行加权来影响文档得分，从而优化结果排名。文本索引的默认语言是英语。若要更改默认语言，请将 language 属性设置为您想要的语言（例如，@Document(language="spanish")）。使用名为 language 或 @Language 的属性，可以在每个文档级别定义语言覆盖。以下示例展示了如何创建文本索引并将语言设置为西班牙语：

items.source: Map-like properties are skipped by the IndexResolver unless annotated with @WildcardIndexed because the map key must be part of the index definition. Since the purpose of maps is the usage of dynamic keys and values, the keys cannot be resolved from static mapping metadata.
items.translation: 除非使用 @WildcardIndexed 注解，否则 IndexResolver 会跳过类似 Map 的属性，因为映射键必须是索引定义的一部分。由于 Map 的目的是使用动态的键和值，因此无法从静态映射元数据中解析这些键。

items.source: To turn automatic index creation ON please override autoIndexCreation() in your configuration.
items.translation: 要开启自动索引创建，请在配置中覆盖 `autoIndexCreation()` 方法。

items.source: @CompoundIndex is repeatable using @CompoundIndexes as its container.
items.translation: @CompoundIndex 可以通过其容器 @CompoundIndexes 重复使用。

items.source: A WildcardIndex is an index that can be used to include all fields or specific ones based a given (wildcard) pattern. For details, refer to the MongoDB Documentation.
items.translation: WildcardIndex 是一种索引，可用于根据给定的（通配符）模式包含所有字段或特定字段。有关详细信息，请参阅 MongoDB 文档。

items.source: The index can be set up programmatically using WildcardIndex via IndexOperations.
items.translation: 可以通过 IndexOperations 使用 WildcardIndex 以编程方式设置索引。

items.source: Wildcard indexes can also be expressed by adding the annotation directly to the field. Please note that wildcardProjection is not allowed on nested paths such as properties. Projections on types annotated with @WildcardIndexed are omitted during index creation.
items.translation: 通配符索引也可以通过直接在字段上添加注解来表达。 请注意，wildcardProjection 不允许用于嵌套路径（如属性）。 在带有 @WildcardIndexed 注解的类型上的投影在创建索引时会被省略。

items.source: Spring Data MongoDB can automatically create indexes for entity types annotated with @Document. Index creation must be explicitly enabled since version 3.0 to prevent undesired effects with collection lifecycle and performance impact. Indexes are automatically created for the initial entity set on application startup and when accessing an entity type for the first time while the application runs.
items.translation: Spring Data MongoDB 可以为使用 @Document 注解的实体类型自动创建索引。 自版本 3.0 起，必须显式启用索引创建功能，以避免对集合生命周期产生不利影响并降低性能影响。 在应用程序启动时以及应用程序运行期间首次访问某个实体类型时，会自动为初始实体集创建索引。

items.source: Hashed indexes allow hash based sharding within a sharded cluster. Using hashed field values to shard collections results in a more random distribution. For details, refer to the MongoDB Documentation.
items.translation: 哈希索引允许在分片集群中基于哈希进行分片。使用哈希字段值对集合进行分片，可实现更随机的分布。有关详细信息，请参阅MongoDB 文档。

items.source: Here’s an example that creates a hashed index for _id:
items.translation: 此处是一个为 `<code>_id` 创建哈希索引的示例：

items.source: Although index creation via annotations comes in handy for many scenarios cosider taking over more control by setting up indices manually via IndexOperations.
items.translation: 虽然通过注解创建索引在许多场景中非常有用，但也可以考虑通过手动设置索引来掌握更多控制权，即使用IndexOperations。

items.source: The @WildcardIndex annotation allows a declarative index setup that can used either with a document type or property.
items.translation: @WildcardIndex 注解允许对文档类型或属性进行声明式索引配置。

items.source: If placed on a type that is a root level domain entity (one annotated with @Document) , the index resolver will create a wildcard index for it.
items.translation: 如果将其放置在根级别域实体（即带有@Document 注解的类型）上，索引解析器将为其创建一个通配符索引。

items.source: The wildcardProjection can be used to specify keys to in-/exclude in the index.
items.translation: `wildcardProjection` 可用于指定在索引中包含或排除的键。

items.source: We generally recommend explicit index creation for application-based control of indexes as Spring Data cannot automatically create indexes for collections that were recreated while the application was running.
items.translation: 我们通常建议显式创建索引，以便对应用程序进行索引控制，因为 Spring Data 无法为在应用程序运行期间重新创建的集合自动创建索引。

items.source: Compound indexes are also supported. They are defined at the class level, rather than on individual properties.
items.translation: 还支持复合索引。它们是在类级别定义的，而不是在单个属性上定义。
